6. **Time Sensitive: Project Zenith Chart**: Catherine asks for confirmation that the recipient received a new chart for Project Zenith from Jerry, emphasizing the need for feedback to proceed. Tom follows up, asking the recipient to send a confirmation to Catherine's new email (contact@contact.com) and then send feedback to him, noting that Jerry has made significant changes to the project.
